scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @aion/job-posting && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/**/*.test.js" "test/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/contracts.test.js" "dist-test/test/scoring.test.js"
scripts.test:operations: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/operations.test.js"
